title: Member Services Desk Manual, E.7 — Crediting Downside Protection on a Refined Fuels Pre-Buy Booking
content:
Where downside protection sold with a pre-buy booking held on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts falls to be credited, the desk works the money out and records it against that booking. The credit is money taken off what the member owes on the account: the line carries the gallons it was measured on and the posted price it was measured against, it is dated the day the desk works it out, the member sees it on the next statement for the account, and the balance owed drops by exactly the money credited.

## Recording the credit

The credit is recorded with `record_price_protection_credit_43e8349b`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. The desk works the figure out first and passes it in already formed; the tool prices nothing and judges nothing.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `energy_account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the refined fuels or propane account the credit is applied to, as returned by the energy account lookup |
| `contract_reference` | The pre-buy booking reference the protection was sold with, written as EC- followed by six digits, for example EC-330118, taken from the booking line on the account activity. No other form is accepted and it is never left empty |
| `gallons` | The gallons the credit was measured on, in US gallons to 1 decimal place, passed as a decimal number and stored as given with no further rounding |
| `posted_price_per_gallon` | The posted price for the fuel the credit was measured against, in USD per gallon to 4 decimal places, passed as a decimal number and stored as given |
| `protection_credit_usd` | The money credited to the account, in USD to 2 decimal places, passed as a positive decimal number, rounded half to even to 2 decimal places on the way in, and carried onto the account as a credit |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference of the credit line written, the pre-buy booking reference it attaches to, the gallons it was measured on and the money credited in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving that sentence is what indicates the credit line now stands on the account.

### Contract questions

**Does one call ever write more than one credit line?** No. One call writes a single protection credit line onto the account for the booking named.

**What date does the line carry?** The day the desk works the credit out.
